forbidden.subject: admin dashboard link
forbidden.source_text: Guests must never see a link to the admin dashboard.

forbidden.subject: complete purchase button
forbidden.source_text: Guests without payment information should never be presented with a complete purchase button.

required.subject: product list link
required.source_text: The home page must always provide a link to browse products.

required.subject: customer support contact
required.source_text: Users must not fail to find a way to contact customer support.
